verses.1: Thus said Yahweh: “The heavens shall be my throne, and the earth shall be the place where my feet rest. This is the house that you built for me, and this is the place of my rest.”
verses.2: And all these things were done by my hands. They became the words of Jehovah. And I will address them to the poor and those who are in need, and to those who are afraid of my words.
verses.3: The one who cuts the throat of a man, who slaughters him like a dog; he offers as an offering blood from a pig. It’s a reminder of the suffering that comes with it. Even those who choose their own path and their own ways, their souls still suffer.
verses.4: I also choose those who are worthy of being called “my children” and bring them to me. For I have called them, and they do not respond to my words. They do what is evil in my eyes. And they do not follow my commands.
verses.5: Hear the words of the LORD, those who are in distress. Say to your relatives and neighbors: “May your names be blessed by the LORD, so that we may see your joy.” Then they will be glad.
verses.6: The voice of Sha’an from the city; the voice from the palace; the voice of Jehovah, who rewards those who are worthy.
verses.7: Before she began to give birth, before the cord came into her body and she gave birth to a child.
verses.8: Who could hear such things? Who could see such scenes? The earth would be destroyed on that single day. If a nation were to die once, then its children would also die.
verses.9: I will not die, nor will I be trapped. May the LORD say, “If I die and am trapped, then say to your God.”
verses.10: Rejoice over Jerusalem! Reveal in it all your love for her. May she be a source of comfort to all those who mourn for her.
verses.11: So that they may be comforted and rejoice in her presence. So that they may be filled with joy and happiness at her glory.
verses.12: “For thus said Jehovah: ‘I will bring her there as a river of peace, and as a stream that washes away the sins of nations. They shall be washed away by its waters, and their blessings shall be multiplied.’”
verses.13: As a man whose mother comforted me, so I comfort you. And in Jerusalem, you will be comforted as well.
verses.14: And when you see and rejoice in your hearts, and when your own selves bloom like flowers, then the hand of Jehovah will know his servants, and he will take retribution against his enemies.
verses.15: For behold, Jehovah will come in fire; his chariots will be covered with flames. His anger and fury will be revealed through the flames of fire.
verses.16: For in His fire the LORD judges; and by His sword He destroys all evil things. And many of the Lord’s enemies are destroyed.
verses.17: The unclean and those who are to be purified will go into the pools one after another. I eat the flesh of the sheep, the goat, and the calf together. May Jehovah have mercy on them.
verses.18: And I will do their deeds and their thoughts. I will bring about the destruction of all those nations and peoples. They will come and see My glory.
verses.19: And I have set them as refugees among the nations. They are the people of Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Mishkeni, Keshet, Tubal, and Yawan. These are distant nations who did not hear my voice or see my glory. But they will speak of my glory in those nations.
verses.20: And they shall bring all their offerings from all the nations, as sacrifices to the LORD. They shall bring them in chariots, and in horses, and in trucks, and in animals of various kinds. They shall bring them on the holy mountain in Jerusalem. The LORD said, “When the children of Israel bring their offerings into the house of the LORD, they must do so in a pure manner.”
verses.21: And I will also take them for the priests to offer as sacrifices, said Jehovah.
verses.22: For just as the new heavens and the new earth, which I am creating, stand before me, so also will your descendants and your names stand there.
verses.23: And on the first day of the month, and on the day of Shabbat, every person should come to worship before Him. The Lord said: “Let them come.”
verses.24: And they went out and saw the carcasses of the wicked people. They were not buried nor burned; they remained exposed to all eyes.
